changelog: Corrects the outlier rule (percentage OR Tukey fence), documents that the outlier key is present only when true, adds the quality block and per-price median_basis, and replaces the claim that EV tariffs are not in open data with what pitstop actually parses. Requires pitstop-cli>=1.1.0.
summary: Italian fuel-station prices (petrol, diesel, GPL, methane, HVO) and EV charging stations. Find cheapest by municipality / province / brand / coordinate, look up EV chargers near a place, get macro price stats. Backed by MIMIT Osservaprezzi Carburanti, OpenStreetMap (Overpass), and ISTAT comune coordinates. Use for "cheapest diesel near X in Italy", "fuel stations in <comune>", or "EV chargers near <comune>".
